welcomeMessage:
Hey there future friend! We're so happy you want to join our SpecialNeeds.com family. 😊 We're busy making our website a fun, safe, and helpful place for everyone.🌈💕

To join us, all you have to do is put your email in the box below. We'll send you a message as soon as we're ready for you! 💌🥳

You can send along message too if you'd like to say hi! We'd love to hear from you! 🤗
successResponse: Hooray! 🎉 We've saved a spot just for you!
